note: Morgan County MO parcel and assessor data sits on the integritygis services4 ArcGIS server as MO/Morgan_Assessor_Data, but every layer returns 'Token Required' (code 499), so it is login-gated and cannot be queried anonymously. The county GIS viewer (morgangis.integritygis.com/H5) is HTML only. The kcsgis Morgan/Public service that matched 'Morgan County' is Morgan County, Alabama (Hartselle zoning; no parcels at the Missouri sample point). No public Missouri parcel service was found on gis.mo.gov or MSDIS.
